job.title: Business Technology Operations Support Specialist
job.pay_full: $42,840 – $72,000 a year base salary (range spans pay zones; your work location sets the range that applies)

details.about: Samsara's Connected Operations Cloud helps organizations that run physical operations use Internet of Things data to improve safety, efficiency and sustainability. This is an onsite IT Specialist role on the IT Helpdesk team at Samsara's San Francisco headquarters, troubleshooting and helping people with their technology and access.
duties: Help colleagues at headquarters and online resolve tech problems
Manage a ticket queue and look for ways to improve how the team works
Run new hire onboarding: ordering and provisioning laptops and peripherals, managing system access
Support hardware recovery and asset management
Manage office endpoints such as printers, laptops and conference room equipment
Manage employee access to Samsara's cloud infrastructure
Work with IT Specialists on infrastructure projects and upgrades, and document IT policies and procedures
needs: A college degree in a technical program (Computer Science, Information Systems or other STEM field), or 4 years of relevant job experience
Minimum 2 years of help desk or technical support experience
Minimum 1 year working onsite supporting employees in an IT environment
Strong spoken and written communication skills
Availability 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Monday–Friday (Pacific Time) and occasional off-hours support for urgent issues or special events
nice: Knowledge of Apple products (MacBooks, iPhones, etc.)
Experience with enterprise SaaS (G Suite, Slack, Zoom, Okta, etc.)
Experience with a ticketing system (Zendesk, ServiceNow, etc.)
details.benefits: Annual base salary $42,840 – $72,000; the range spans approved pay zones, and your primary work location determines the range that applies. Base pay may vary with city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills and experience. Total rewards combine base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay and equity for eligible roles, plus a professional development stipend and comprehensive health and parental leave plans.
notes: In office 5 days a week at the San Francisco headquarters
Samsara says it does not charge applicants fees at any stage of hiring
